episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Seven years after a lab blast changed his life, Chan returns to Korea and unexpectedly meets Ha-ran, a name he'd long buried.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Ha-ran mistakes him for a stalker, but Chan is cleared. Reunited on a new project, he finds her changed and makes a surprising offer.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Ha-ran rejects Chan's three-month friendship offer, but Chan is undeterred.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: As Chan and Ha-ran grow closer, a mysterious sound begins to haunt him, revealing gaps in his memory.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Chan and Ha-ran find a Gyeongju escape but a resurfacing memory puts Chan in a brewing storm. Unbeknownst to Ha-ran, Chan is drawn into a brewing storm.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Chan's sudden exit for the U.S. leaves Ha-ran reeling. As longing sets in, the three sisters clash and Na-na faces an unexpected incident.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Chan and Ha-ran reunite after his U.S. return. At a SHIM party, their bond grows while Chan starts recording his resurfacing memories.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Ha-ran helps Chan reveal his father's watch secret. After their reconciliation, Ha-ran wins an award but meets a shocking face at the ceremony.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Chan's unintentional lie about the fountain pen weighs on his conscience. To stay close to Ha-ran, he must decide if the truth is worth the risk.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Chan's envy of Su-jin and Ha-ran grows. As Ha-ran celebrates Chan's birthday, she moves past her "winter" while Na-na makes a choice in Chuncheon.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: Ha-ran, who learns Chan's secret from seven years ago through the "1-Inch of Memory" notebook, falls into confusion upon realizing that even the fountain pen was a gift he had prepared.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: After their trial ends, Haran learns the truth. Chan has vanished, but discovering his feelings, she goes to find him.
